architecture: neural local controller + known-map planner + LiDAR scan-matched command odometry + safety filter
scope: Known-map navigation. This release does not implement online SLAM.

evidence.fixed_gazebo: 13/13 episodes on 12 distinct geometries, zero wall contacts
evidence.reload_reliability: 90/90 episodes on 45 generated geometries, each run twice, zero wall contacts
evidence.noisy_scan_match_gazebo: 15/15 generated mazes, 1.5 cm LiDAR noise, 5% ray dropout, +3% linear/-3% angular odometry scale, zero wall contacts
evidence.packaged_model_smoke: promoted local_policy.pt reloaded from release_latest and reached goal with the same sensor/odometry stress, zero wall contacts

limitations: Gazebo only; no physical robot validation
